purpose: Counterexamples for local decision-linter and replay calibration; not a model benchmark.

cases.task: Optimize this PostgreSQL query; no incorrect result is reported.
cases.reason: Optimization without a stated defect is not bug-fix.

cases.task: Summarize our brand guidelines for the regional campaign team.
cases.reason: A referenced-but-unsupplied input is a capability gap, not invented content.

cases.task: Why does my form submission return a 403 after enabling CSRF protection?
cases.reason: Diagnosing a security symptom does not change a security boundary.

cases.task: Add a docstring to one function.
cases.reason: An edit inside a source file is code, not authored content.

cases.task: Update the copyright year in the site footer.
cases.reason: A content edit is not automatically a code deliverable.

cases.task: Reconcile the general ledger and document control exceptions for month-end close.
cases.reason: A control finding is an audit deliverable, not financial analysis.

cases.task: Analyze a budget-versus-actual variance and show forecast assumptions.

expected.risk_basis: organizational financial records and approval boundaries

cases.reason: Organizational financial assumptions carry compliance boundaries.

cases.task: Write an executive status update with decisions, risks, owners, and next actions.
cases.reason: Multiple required sections make this moderate, and reporting on project operations is data risk.

cases.task: Design a workflow for an unfamiliar municipal water utility during drought.
cases.reason: Unknown-domain multi-party coordination needs bounded discovery.

cases.task: What does the JWT exp claim mean?
cases.reason: A factual security question is not automatically a security action.

cases.task: Add PII fields to the user model.

expected.risk_basis: personal data crosses a storage boundary

cases.reason: Implementation plus privacy boundary requires security review.

cases.task: Compare two unfamiliar products and cite sources.
cases.reason: Unfamiliar product facts require a bounded gap, not invented knowledge.

cases.task: Write a short status message for the team about the completed build.
cases.reason: Ordinary communication is not automatically data risk.

cases.task: Set up a GitHub Actions CI pipeline with lint, test, and build steps.
cases.reason: Substantial technical work is still none; data risk is about subject matter, not size.

cases.task: Turn this handwritten field note into a structured action list.
cases.reason: An action list tells the reader what to do next, so it is a plan rather than a document.

cases.task: Write a threat model for the payment processing flow.
cases.reason: A threat model is security work even though it changes nothing.

cases.task: Test a vendor security control and write an evidence-backed audit finding.

expected.risk_basis: vendor assurance finding needs an approved control standard

cases.reason: A third party in the subject material makes the vendor domain material too.

cases.task: Explain the social implications of a new agricultural cooperative.
cases.reason: Explaining an organization is still information, so it stays none.

cases.task: Set up a GitHub Actions CI pipeline with lint, test, and build steps.
cases.reason: Configuration that defines an automated repeatable process is workflow, not code.

cases.task: Test a vendor security control and write an evidence-backed audit finding.

expected.risk_basis: the finding must meet an approved control standard

cases.reason: The deliverable decides the risk; an assurance finding is compliance even with a security subject.

cases.task: Turn this handwritten field note into a structured action list.
cases.reason: Personal material is not an organizational record, so data risk does not apply.

cases.task: Compare two unfamiliar products and cite sources and confidence.
cases.reason: A comparison becomes a recommendation only when a choice was requested.
